Europe’s summer of extreme heat has caused the Danube’s water level to hit record lows , affecting power production at the Paks nuclear plant. Hungarian authorities are sinking the two barges to raise water levels so Paks, which provides the country with more than a third of its electricity , can continue to operate normally.
